integrity: New classification proven by a first-two-moments equality argument and exact two-state reduction; finite verifier is supplemental. Established source definitions and related results are attributed. No independent external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite connected simple loopless undirected unweighted graphs, a single rank-one marked oracle, degree-reversible random-walk Laplacian and stationary initial state. Exact finite-time success only, not approximate/asymptotic success or arbitrary weighted models.
title: Perfect continuous-time random-walk search occurs exactly at cones over regular graphs
